context: Mrs. Mori shows Yumiko her summer vegetables.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: Yumiko-san, look at these summer vegetables.
lines.style: Bright, warm opening with genuine delight. Quick lift on the invitation to look. Excited but unhurried — the pleasure of sharing something real with a trusted neighbor.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.en: Wonderful! Those tomatoes are really something.
lines.style: Warm appreciative tone with genuine admiration. Soft landing on each phrase. The voice of someone who means her compliments and savours the moment of connection.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 一緒に、収穫、しましょう。
lines.style: Gentle invitation with quiet enthusiasm. Open, unhurried pacing. The warmth of inclusion in the voice — not commanding, inviting.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 楽しい。森さん、いつも元気。
lines.en: It's so much fun. Mori-san, you're always so energetic.
lines.style: Affectionate observation layered under the words. Tender noticing of her neighbor's constancy. Slight pause before the compliment — genuine reflection, not performance.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: お互い、これからも、元気でね。
lines.en: Let's both stay healthy for many years to come.
lines.style: Soft, steady close. A gentle promise held lightly in the voice. Warmth with weight — the kind of wish you make to someone who matters, unhurried and sincere.
